title: Key Account Director - Facility Management
description:
**About the Company:**
Our client is a global leader in Integrated Facility Management and Workplace Services, supporting large organisations in managing complex, technology-enabled workplace and facilities operations across multiple locations. With a strong focus on operational excellence, safety, sustainability, workplace experience and digital transformation, the organisation partners with leading businesses to improve service quality, productivity and efficiency through people, technology, data and innovative solutions.

**About the Role**
: We are looking for an accomplished
**Key Account Director (KAD)**
to lead and manage a large, complex portfolio of Integrated Facility Management contract. The role carries end-to-end accountability for client relationships, operational delivery, people, financial performance, HSE, technology adoption and continuous improvement across the portfolio.

The KAD will operate as the face of the organisation with the client, translating contractual commitments into consistently high service performance while identifying opportunities to improve productivity, enhance employee experience and grow the partnership.

This is a leadership role requiring the ability to manage large teams, multiple sites, diverse service lines and senior client stakeholders in a demanding corporate environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
:

**Client & Account Management**

* Act as the senior point of accountability for the client portfolio.
* Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders across Corporate Real Estate, Facilities, Procurement, Finance, HSE and business leadership.
* Lead governance through structured operational reviews and executive-level engagements.
* Drive client satisfaction, retention and long-term partnership growth.

**Operational & P&L Leadership**

* Lead end-to-end delivery across a large, multi-site IFM portfolio covering technical and soft services.
* Oversee MEP, HVAC, electrical, engineering, housekeeping, workplace services, helpdesk, transport, vendors and subcontractors.
* Own the account P&L, budgeting, forecasting, cost optimisation and commercial performance.
* Identify opportunities for productivity improvement, additional services and organic account growth.

**People Leadership**

* Lead large, geographically distributed teams across multiple locations and service lines.
* Build a strong leadership pipeline and drive employee engagement, capability development and performance.
* Ensure manpower availability and operational discipline across the account.

**HSE & Compliance**

* Drive a strong Health, Safety & Environment culture across the portfolio.
* Ensure statutory, regulatory and contractual compliance.
* Lead hazard identification, incident prevention, root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

**Technology & Innovation**

* Drive adoption of CAFM/CMMS, workforce management, digital helpdesk, IoT and digital inspection solutions.
* Use data analytics and dashboards to improve operational visibility and decision-making.
* Leverage automation and AI-enabled solutions to improve productivity, predictive maintenance, energy optimisation and service delivery.
* Drive continuous improvement through process redesign, mechanisation and technology adoption.

**Experience and Qualifications**
:

* 15 - 20 years of progressive leadership experience in
  **Integrated Facility Management / Corporate Real Estate Services**
  .
* Proven experience managing large, complex and multi-site IFM portfolios.
* Strong understanding of both technical and soft services.
* Demonstrated P&L ownership and commercial management experience.
* Experience leading large, manpower-intensive operations.
* Strong client relationship and account governance experience, including CXO-level stakeholders.
* Strong HSE and statutory compliance orientation.
* Exposure to technology-enabled FM operations, analytics and digital transformation.
* Comfortable with AI, automation and emerging workplace technologies.
* Experience in employee transportation/mobility operations will be an advantage.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and problem-solving skills.
* Engineering, Facility Management or Business Management qualification preferred.

title: Service Delivery Manager - Payroll
description:
**Service Delivery Manager – Payroll**

*Global Process Owner, Payroll & Reward Operations (R2P)*

**Tower:**
Reward to Pay (R2P)

**Location:**
Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

**Reports to:**
HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

**Role type:**
People manager

**Scope:**
Multi-country payroll, benefits administration, compensation changes, payroll accounting and tax filings

**ABOUT THE HUB**

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

You own payroll and reward delivery end to end for every country moving into Noida. You will move payroll from dozens of local vendors and in-country teams to a controlled, consolidated model. Employees must be paid accurately and on time, in every cycle and in every country, throughout the transition and after it.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Transition and shared services set-up**

* Lead the payroll transition roadmap country by country, sequenced by risk, complexity, headcount and vendor contract dates.
* Run knowledge transfer from country payroll teams and vendors. This covers desk procedures, statutory calendars, pay elements and local exceptions.
* Plan and run parallel payroll runs for each country. Set clear go/no-go criteria based on variance thresholds, and use hypercare after cutover.
* Deliver the global payroll vendor consolidation programme. Rationalise the vendor portfolio, support selection, and manage exit and onboarding without disrupting pay.
* Design the target operating model for R2P, covering the split of work between hub, vendor and country HR, with RACI, handoffs and cut-off calendars.

**2. Process ownership and service delivery**

* Act as Global Process Owner for R2P. Own process standards, the global pay calendar, the design of allowed variations, and change control.
* Deliver zero critical payroll errors per cycle through pre-payroll reconciliations, input validation, dual approval and post-pay checks.
* Monitor data flows between the HRIS, time-and-attendance, payroll engines and the general ledger. Resolve interface breaks before cut-off.
* Manage payroll vendors against contractual SLAs, with monthly scorecards, quarterly business reviews and service credits where needed.
* Act as the escalation point for pay issues. Run root-cause analysis on every off-cycle payment and track the fix through to closure.

**3. Governance, risk and controls**

* Build and maintain the R2P control framework, including key controls, segregation of duties, access reviews and evidence standards.
* Lead annual and ad-hoc audit readiness with Internal Audit, Tax and Finance. Close findings within the agreed timelines.
* Track statutory and regulatory change in every in-scope country. Implement change before its effective date.
* Protect employee pay data in line with GDPR and local privacy law.

**4. Continuous improvement and digital**

* Standardise pay elements and processes across countries. Reduce local exceptions to the minimum required by law.
* Automate reconciliations, variance analysis and exception reporting using RPA and analytics.
* Drive employee self-service for payslips, tax documents and pay queries to reduce inbound contacts.

**5. People leadership, performance and culture**

* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* First 90 days: R2P operating model, country wave plan and control framework signed off.
* By go-live: first wave of countries live in Noida after successful parallel runs.
* Within 12–18 months: vendor consolidation on track, zero critical errors sustained, and a clean audit outcome.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

**Indicative target**

**Payroll accuracy:**
≥ 99.5% of payslips error-free; zero critical errors

**On-time payment:**
100% of payrolls paid on the scheduled date

**Off-cycle payments:**
Reduced quarter on quarter; every case root-caused

**Statutory compliance:**
Zero penalties; 100% filings on time

**Vendor SLA adherence:**
≥ 98% against contracted SLAs

**Cost per payslip:**
Year-on-year reduction against baseline

**Audit outcome:**
No high-rated findings

*Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines.*

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* Deep multi-country payroll expertise covering gross-to-net, statutory deductions, tax and social security, and year-end.
* Payroll vendor and aggregator management (for example ADP, Ramco, Alight, or in-country providers), including contract and SLA governance.
* Payroll controls, SOX-style frameworks and audit management.
* Integration of HRIS (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors) with time and payroll systems, including interface monitoring.
* Payroll accounting, GL reconciliation and working knowledge of benefits administration.
* Parallel-run design, cutover planning and hypercare.

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**

• Builds teams from zero

• Customer-centric leadership

• Drives change and adoption

• Sound judgement under pressure

• Influences without authority across countries

• Data-led decision making

• Coaches and develops talent

• Holds a high bar on control

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

**Essential**

* 15+ years in HR operations, including 8+ years leading multi-country payroll.
* Has led at least one payroll transition or vendor consolidation into a shared services centre.
* Has run payroll for 10,000+ employees across several jurisdictions.
* Master's degree in HR, Finance, Business or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Payroll certification (CPP, FPC, CIPP or equivalent)
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or above
* Experience across Europe, Middle East, Africa or APAC payroll

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**

Hub Director, Global Reward and Payroll leadership, Finance and Tax, Internal Audit, country HR leads, payroll vendors, HRIS team.

title: People Services Digital Learning Experience Lead
description:
**OUR STORY**
**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**
**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**
**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**
**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Learning Technology Leadership**

* Own the overall learning technology experience across the LMS/LXP ecosystem, ensuring a seamless and user-friendly learner journey.
* Act as the primary point of contact for learning technology governance, standards, and process control.
* Partner with HR Innovation, HRMS, IT, and global/regional HR stakeholders to define system enhancements and digital learning priorities.
* Evaluate and recommend learning technology improvements, automation opportunities, and digital adoption initiatives.
* Support the rollout of new learning technologies, features, and tools, ensuring business readiness and stakeholder alignment.

**Governance and Process Control**

* Define, maintain, and enforce governance standards for LMS processes, content lifecycle, user access, workflows, and data quality.
* Ensure process consistency across countries, regions, and business units while accommodating local compliance requirements.
* Maintain documentation for learning technology processes, controls, SOPs, and user support procedures.
* Monitor adherence to global learning processes and identify gaps, risks, and control breakdowns.
* Drive continuous improvement by simplifying workflows, reducing manual interventions, and standardizing operations.

**Stakeholder and Vendor Management**

* Act as the escalation point for learning technology and governance-related issues.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and vendors to resolve system, process, and access issues in a timely manner.
* Support system testing, user acceptance testing, and defect resolution for LMS-related changes or enhancements.
* Coordinate with vendors and technical partners to ensure service levels and issue resolution targets are met.

**Leadership Management**

* Lead, coach, and develop team members supporting learning operations, reporting, or systems administration.
* Allocate responsibilities, monitor workload, and ensure service continuity and quality.
* Conduct performance reviews, regular check-ins, and development planning for direct reports.
* Build capability within the team on learning systems, governance standards, and process excellence.

**Reporting and Insights**

* Oversee the quality and reliability of learning data, dashboards, and management reporting.
* Track platform usage, adoption, learner engagement, completion rates, and system/data issues.
* Provide insights to support leadership decision-making and identify improvement areas.

**Opportunities**

* Shape the transformation of learning services through automation, analytics, and digital user experience.
* Influence global learning governance standards and service model design.
* Contribute to the maturity of the L&D function as a digitally enabled service.

**Qualifications**

* Over 6 years’ experience in HR Services, L&D operations, learning technology, or HR systems roles.
* Strong experience with LMS/LXP platforms and learning operations governance.
* Proven ability to manage cross-functional stakeholders and lead process improvement initiatives.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and control discipline.
* Experience working with HR systems such as Oracle, Workday, CSOD, SuccessFactors, or SAP.
* Familiarity with service management tools such as ServiceNow.
* Advanced Excel/reporting skills and experience with dashboards or learning analytics.
* Experience leading people and/or coordinating multi-country workstreams.
* Lean Six Sigma or equivalent process improvement certification preferred.

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance.
  
  
At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.

description:

title: Lead PPC Operations
description:
**Position:**
Lead PPC Operations (Google Ads, Meta Ads and emerging ad platforms)

**Location:**
Hybrid / Remote, full-time

**Website:**
https://www.remedo.io/

**Role Overview:**

Remedo, a healthcare-focused digital marketing agency serving dental and medical practices in the US and UK.

Remedo is looking for a hands-on
**Lead PPC Operations (Google Ads, Meta Ads and emerging ad platforms)**
to run our paid media function end to end. You will own day-to-day operations of the ads team, the health of 50+ client ad accounts, and the results we deliver. This is a player-coach role: you lead the team, stay close to the work, step in on accounts yourself to help solve complex problems, and are accountable for outcomes, not just activity. You will work across Google Ads and Meta Ads today and help us build capability on newer channels such as Apple Search Ads and LLM / AI-assistant ads.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Lead the team:**
  coach and review the ads team, set priorities and standards, and own hiring, onboarding and performance reviews.
* **Own daily operations:**
  monitor budget pacing, spend anomalies, disapprovals, tracking breaks and lead quality across all accounts, with a clear daily and weekly check rhythm and SOPs.
* **Own results:**
  be accountable for account performance against client goals (cost per lead, lead quality, ROAS, booked appointments); diagnose underperformance independently and drive the fix.
* **Step up with clients:**
  lead the ads discussion in strategy and review calls, explain results and decisions clearly, and own ads escalations.
* **Work across teams:**
  collaborate closely with account management, SEO, content, web and design on landing pages, tracking, handovers and client goals.
* **Platforms and measurement:**
  strategy and optimization in Google Ads and Meta Ads; sound tracking with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel and Conversions API.
* **Emerging channels and AI:**
  pilot Apple Search Ads and LLM ad formats, and use AI and automation to make the team faster and more accurate.
* **Healthcare compliance:**
  follow ad policies and data-privacy requirements for dental and medical clients in the US and UK.

**Requirements:**

* 4 to 6 years in paid media or performance marketing, ideally in an agency managing multiple client accounts (slightly less is fine for a fast learner with strong results).
* Experience leading or mentoring a team (2 to 3+ people), or clear readiness to step up.
* Strong hands-on command of Google Ads and Meta Ads, including lead generation, with a record of improving cost per lead and lead quality.
* Solid measurement skills: GA4, Google Tag Manager, Pixel / Conversions API, conversion tracking.
* Runs daily operations independently: spots problems early, sets priorities, closes issues. Hands-on by nature and happy to work directly in accounts and cover for teammates.
* Confident leading client conversations, presenting results and handling escalations; collaborates smoothly with other teams.

**Good to have:**
healthcare or local-service clients; Apple, Microsoft, LinkedIn or TikTok Ads and early LLM ads exposure; SOPs, dashboards (Looker Studio) or automation (scripts, n8n); Google and Meta certifications; US / UK time-zone experience.

**What success looks like:**

**30 days:**
know every account and its goals, audit tracking and account health, and agree an operating rhythm with the VP of Operations.

**60 days:**
daily health checks running reliably, reporting standardized, a clear owner and plan for every account, and the top 3 underperforming accounts on a recovery plan.

**90 days:**
consistent team output, no unnoticed budget or tracking issues, and ads escalations handled without leadership involvement.

title: ADN-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Assurance – Manager**
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for individuals who are qualified accountants with excellent leadership skills.
  
  
The incumbent gets an excellent opportunity to work virtually or directly with the engagement teams across Americas and Europe, and develop knowledge of international accounting and assurance principles
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support a portfolio of engagements, by leading a team of Assistant Managers, Seniors and Associates
* Ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY methodology and in line with the engagement team’s expectations
* Demonstrate strong understanding of EY methodology in service delivery and supporting various quality projects, such as pre-issuance reviews, assurance quality reviews, efficiency projects and others.
* Develop and maintain productive relationships with key engagement team counterparts, such as Assurance executives based in Americas or Europe.
* Develop an understanding of EY Risk Management procedures and ensure that these are embedded into the engagement team’s work.
* Work closely with the engagement team to transition new engagements and services to GDS Assurance while maintaining the highest levels of quality of service.
* Proactively discuss work flow management with the engagement teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one’s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
* Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and engagement teams.
* Establish expectations regarding value to be delivered to the respective aligned GDS or engagement teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS Assurance.
* Standardize assurance processes along with leveraging best practices across one’s aligned engagements or beyond.
* Help team members grow by encouraging them to actively contribute to the team.
* Lead by example, delegate work successfully and develop and maintain high performing teams.
* Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback and training.
* Use technology and tools to continually learn, share knowledge with team members, and enhance service delivery.
* Contribute to technical and soft-skills training to continually develop the team’s skills.
* Actively participate in organizational initiatives, such as recruitment, diversity and inclusiveness, trainings, and others.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Expert knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards
* Knowledge of UK GAAP or US GAAP and International assurance standards is an added advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
* Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
* Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
* The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) with 5-6 years of post-qualification relevant experience
* Qualified ACCA / CPA with 7-8 years of post-qualification relevant experience
* Articleship with other top or mid -tier accounting firms
* Experience in either

+ Mid-or top-tier accounting firm focused on external or Assurance reviews / matters
+ MNC or larger Indian companies, preferably within a Shared Service Environment.
+ Big 4 Firms - Indian & Global practice

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Proficiency in MS – Excel, MS – Office.
* Interest in business and commerciality.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior S&OP & Supply Chain Lead
description:
**We are hiring for Senior S&OP & Supply Chain Lead**

**Location:**
Noida, Sector 80

**Joining:**
Immediate joiners preferred

**About The Cinnamon Kitchen**

The Cinnamon Kitchen (TCK) is a fast-growing food brand with a manufacturing-led, multi-channel business model. As we scale across Quick Commerce, D2C and marketplaces, we are looking for a
**Senior S&OP & Supply Chain Lead**
to own end-to-end demand and supply planning, production alignment, inventory health and replenishment.

This role is ideal for someone who has
**hands-on experience managing Quick Commerce supply chains and short shelf-life food products**
, with a strong understanding of platform-level demand, replenishment cycles, inventory ageing, expiry control and production planning.

The person will work closely with the Founder and leadership team to build a robust, data-driven planning function that improves availability, reduces wastage and optimises working capital.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. S&OP and Demand Planning**

* Lead the end-to-end S&OP process, aligning Sales, Quick Commerce, Marketing, Production, Procurement and Finance.
* Build SKU-level demand forecasts using historical sales, platform data, promotions, seasonality and new product launches.
* Translate Quick Commerce demand trends and sales run rates into actionable supply plans.
* Track forecast accuracy, identify demand variances and improve planning reliability.
* Establish weekly and monthly demand-supply reviews with clear action plans.

**2. Quick Commerce Planning and Replenishment**

* Own supply planning and replenishment across Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart and other relevant Quick Commerce platforms.
* Understand platform-level sales velocity, stock cover, replenishment frequency, fill rates, stock-outs and inventory requirements.
* Plan inventory allocation across dark stores, warehouses and distribution points based on demand and shelf-life constraints.
* Coordinate with platform teams and internal stakeholders to improve product availability and reduce lost sales.
* Monitor SKU-level performance and proactively address supply gaps, excess stock and ageing inventory.

**3. Shelf-Life and Inventory Optimisation**

* Drive inventory planning for short shelf-life, perishable or expiry-sensitive food and FMCG products.
* Establish SKU-wise inventory norms, safety stock, minimum order quantities and replenishment parameters.
* Monitor batch-level ageing, expiry dates, remaining shelf life and FEFO (First Expired, First Out) adherence.
* Balance product availability with production lead times, shelf-life limits and platform-specific remaining shelf-life requirements.
* Minimise expiry-related losses, dead stock, excess production and inventory obsolescence.

**4. Production and Capacity Planning**

* Convert demand forecasts into weekly and daily production plans.
* Align production schedules with order commitments, product shelf life, manufacturing capacity and raw-material availability.
* Optimise production sequencing, batch sizes and capacity utilisation.
* Anticipate demand spikes, promotional requirements and new launches to prevent supply disruptions.
* Work closely with manufacturing teams to improve production adherence and reduce finished-goods ageing.

**5. Procurement and Material Planning**

* Own MRP and material requirement planning for ingredients, packaging and other critical materials.
* Align procurement schedules with demand forecasts, production plans, vendor lead times and minimum order quantities.
* Identify supply risks and establish contingency plans for critical materials.
* Improve material availability while controlling excess raw-material inventory and expiry losses.

**6. Supply Chain Performance and Leadership**

* Build dashboards to track forecast accuracy, OTIF, fill rates, stock-outs, inventory cover, ageing and wastage.
* Establish structured planning reviews, escalation mechanisms and cross-functional accountability.
* Identify bottlenecks across production, warehousing, replenishment and distribution.
* Drive continuous improvement in service levels, inventory efficiency, operating costs and working capital.
* Present actionable insights and supply-chain risks to senior leadership.

**What We're Looking For**

* **6–12 years of relevant experience**
  in S&OP, demand planning, supply planning or supply-chain management.
* **Mandatory hands-on experience with Quick Commerce operations**
  , particularly replenishment, inventory availability and SKU-level planning across platforms such as Blinkit, Zepto or Swiggy Instamart.
* **Strong experience managing short shelf-life, expiry-sensitive or perishable products**
  , preferably in food, bakery, dairy, fresh food, chilled products or relevant FMCG categories.
* Demonstrated expertise in demand forecasting, inventory optimisation, production planning and replenishment.
* Practical understanding of batch-level inventory, FEFO, remaining shelf-life norms, stock ageing and expiry reduction.
* Experience working with manufacturing, procurement, warehousing and distribution teams.

**Preferred backgrounds:**
Quick Commerce-led food brands, D2C food/FMCG businesses, food manufacturing, bakery, dairy, fresh or chilled food businesses, and companies managing high SKU velocity with limited product shelf life.

**Education**

B.Tech/B.E. or MBA/PGDM in Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics or a related discipline preferred.

**Why Join TCK?**

* Own and strengthen the S&OP function of a growing food brand.
* Work directly with the Founder and leadership team.
* Build scalable planning systems across manufacturing and Quick Commerce.
* Make a measurable impact on product availability, wastage, profitability and business growth.

**How to Apply**

Share your CV at
**career@cinnamon.kitchen**

Candidate Name – Senior S&OP & Supply Chain Lead

* Coordinate readiness across testing, cutover, go-live, hypercare and formal workstream/SOW closure.
* Ensure agreed decisions and corrective actions are translated into delivery activity and closed to evidence.

Own the programme governance and control framework, ensuring the right issues are considered by the right forum, decisions are made at the appropriate level and actions, risks and commitments are transparently controlled.

* Ensure timely submission of timesheets and accurate billing information to support project financials and revenue recognition.

* Support proposal development, resource planning, and contract preparation by providing staffing estimates and resource availability.
* Drive continuous process improvements in resource planning, operational reporting, and utilization management.

* 5+ years of experience in consulting, resource management, project operations or PMO.
* Experience in system implementation or consulting projects, preferably within the Life Sciences or Pharmacovigilance industry.
* Experience supporting process improvement, data migration, or enterprise implementation projects.
* Strong understanding of resource planning, capacity management, utilization forecasting, and workforce planning.
* Experience working with resource management and project management tools.
* Experience collaborating with Finance, Human Resources, Recruiting, and Delivery teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with consulting services organizations or software implementation firms.
* Knowledge of project financials, revenue forecasting, and utilization reporting.
* Experience supporting global delivery teams and distributed resource models.

* Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills.

title: Admissions Manager
description:
**Designation:**
Admissions Manager

**Business Unit:**
Global Study Partner (GSP)

**Location:**
Noida

**Working Days:**
5 days, Monday to Friday

**Work Mode:**
Work from Office

**About the Role**

The Manager – Visa & Admissions will lead the University-Facing Admissions Team, responsible for driving application outcomes and managing post-submission processes across assigned international study destinations. The role will oversee the end-to-end university-facing journey, including securing offers, managing Genuine Student (GS) requirements, obtaining Letters of Acceptance (LOAs), coordinating Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) issuance, and ensuring timely closure of university requirements.

The ideal candidate will bring strong international admissions expertise, university relationship management experience, and the ability to lead a team, streamline processes, manage escalations, and consistently deliver against turnaround times and operational targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Team Leadership and Performance Management

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of Admissions Officers responsible for university-facing processes across assigned destinations.
* Allocate portfolios based on destination expertise, workload, and business priorities.
* Define team targets, monitor individual and team performance, and ensure timely closure of applications.
* Conduct regular reviews, provide coaching, and build destination-specific expertise within the team.
* Drive accountability, productivity, accuracy, and adherence to defined turnaround times.

2. Application Outcomes and Offer Management

* Oversee the follow-up and closure of university applications, ensuring timely receipt of offers and admission decisions.
* Monitor pending applications, identify bottlenecks, and establish escalation mechanisms to minimise delays.
* Ensure application outcomes are tracked accurately and that pending cases are prioritised based on intake deadlines and business requirements.
* Coordinate with application submission teams and other internal stakeholders to resolve application-related issues.

3. GS, LOA, CAS and Destination-Specific Compliance

* Oversee GS (Genuine Student) filing and related university requirements for applicable destinations.
* Ensure timely issuance of LOAs, CAS and other relevant admission documents, including CoE where applicable.
* Monitor fulfilment of offer conditions, documentation requirements, deposit confirmations, and other prerequisites.
* Ensure the team follows destination-specific university policies, admission requirements, compliance guidelines, and process updates.
* Identify recurring documentation gaps and implement corrective measures to improve processing quality.

4. University Relationship Management

* Build and strengthen relationships with admissions teams and key contacts at partner universities.
* Act as the escalation point for delayed decisions, complex cases, documentation issues, and university-side concerns.
* Establish effective communication channels with university partners to improve turnaround times and application outcomes.
* Stay updated on university entry requirements, intake timelines, policy changes, and admission processes.
* Share relevant updates and ensure the team implements changes across assigned destinations.

5. Process Excellence and Operational Efficiency

* Develop and optimise SOPs, workflows, tracking mechanisms, and escalation matrices for university-facing operations.
* Identify process gaps affecting offer conversion, document issuance, and application closure, and implement improvement initiatives.
* Ensure accurate and timely updates across CRM systems, university portals, trackers, and management reports.
* Standardise reporting and follow-up practices across the team to improve visibility and operational control.
* Drive continuous improvements in processing time, quality, and overall stakeholder experience.

6. Stakeholder Management and Cross-Functional Coordination

* Collaborate with Application Submission, Student Counselling, Visa, Student Success, and other internal teams to ensure smooth case progression.
* Keep Regional Partners (RPs) and relevant stakeholders informed about application outcomes, pending requirements, and next steps.
* Ensure students receive the required university documentation and that cases are handed over seamlessly to the next stage.
* Partner with business leaders and internal stakeholders to address operational challenges and meet intake-related priorities.

7. MIS, Reporting and Business Reviews

* Track and report key operational metrics, including offer turnaround time, LOA/CAS issuance, pending applications, SLA adherence, and case closure rates.
* Prepare regular dashboards and performance reports for leadership reviews.
* Analyse trends, identify recurring delays, and recommend data-driven interventions.
* Maintain accurate records and ensure compliance with internal reporting and documentation standards.

**Qualifications and Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; a relevant postgraduate qualification would be an advantage.
* 5–8 years of experience in international admissions, study-abroad operations, university liaison, or application processing.
* At least 2–3 years of experience in team leadership or people management.
* Strong working knowledge of international admissions and post-offer processes for destinations such as the UK, Australia, Canada, or other major study-abroad markets.
* Hands-on understanding of GS requirements, CAS issuance, LOAs, CoE, offer conditions, and university documentation processes, as applicable to assigned destinations.
* Proven experience managing university relationships, escalations, multiple application pipelines, and intake-driven deadlines.
* Experience tracking operational KPIs, managing SLAs, preparing MIS reports, and improving team productivity.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Proficiency in CRM systems, university portals, MS Office, and Google Workspace.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment and manage competing priorities effectively.

**Key Skills**

* Team Leadership and Performance Management
* International Admissions Operations
* University Relationship Management
* Offer, LOA, CAS and CoE Management
* GS and Destination-Specific Compliance
* Process Improvement and SOP Management
* Escalation and Stakeholder Management

* Operational Planning and Workload Management
* Attention to Detail and Deadline Management

**Working Arrangement**

* Mandatory work-from-office attendance on all working days.

AlignEdge Talent Advisory is hiring for a reputed manufacturing organisation based in Greater Noida. We are looking for two experienced professionals for the roles below.

**ROLE 1: Manager / Sr. Manager – Costing & Estimation (Planning & Projects)**

**About the role:**

You will provide strong production planning and costing skills to maintain quality, schedules and budgets across projects.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Prepare accurate BOM, BOQ, estimates and product costing for metal and wood products
* Develop production plans, budgets and timelines as per production specifications
* Determine production requirements based on plant capacity
* Plan workflow and schedules for production departments
* Monitor production status, identify delays and adjust schedules to meet deadlines
* Assist in production risk assessment and mitigation
* Determine equipment, materials and manpower required for production
* Ensure finished products meet quality standards and customer specifications
* Conduct daily meetings to track production schedules
* Evaluate current processes and recommend improvements
* Resolve production issues and escalate unresolved issues to management

**Candidate profile:**

* Diploma in Mechanical / B.Tech
* 10–15 years of experience in furniture / shop fit-out manufacturing
* Extensive experience in production planning
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD (2D/3D)
* Excellent presentation, spoken and written communication skills

**ROLE 2: Manager – Powder Coating (Production)**

**About the role:**

You will manage the Powder Coating section of the production department, owning day-to-day operations, targets, quality, delivery schedules, cost efficiency and safety compliance.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Manage daily Powder Coating operations to meet production targets, quality and delivery schedules
* Manage manpower, machines, materials, powder and chemical consumption with minimum wastage
* Ensure proper execution of the full process: pretreatment, powder application, curing and final inspection
* Monitor colour matching, surface finish, DFT, adhesion and curing parameters
* Identify and resolve defects such as colour variation, poor adhesion, pinholes, orange peel and uneven coating
* Control direct costs, rejection, rework and wastage
* Lead, train and develop the team, ensuring safety and quality compliance
* Coordinate with Production, Quality, Planning and Maintenance teams
* Maintain production, quality and consumption MIS reports and drive continuous improvement

**Candidate profile:**

* Diploma in Mechanical / BE / B.Tech
* 10–15 years of experience in a Powder Coating section (sheet metal / metal furniture industry)
* Extensive experience in operations / plant management
* Excellent presentation, spoken and written communication skills

Greater Noida

**Employment type:**
Full-time, on-site

Email your resume at
**info@alignedge.in**
with the role name in the subject line (e.g. “Powder Coating Manager” or “Costing & Estimation Manager”).

title: FAAS Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS- Assurance FAAS – Manager – Trade Operations Specialist**
In a world that is changing faster than ever, our purpose acts as our ‘North Star’ guiding our more than 300,000 people – providing the context and meaning for the work we do every day. In doing so, we play a critical role in
**building a better working world**
for our people, clients and communities. Thanks to our innovative services in auditing, tax consulting as well as transaction and management consulting, we proudly drive our clients into the future. As the only one of the Big 4 with a specialist cross-border practice dedicated to the Financial Services Sector, we offer our clients seamless, consistent and high-quality services around the globe. With our Assurance Services, we strengthen public confidence in global capital markets and promote sustainable growth. If you are looking to develop your individual skills whilst working in interdisciplinary and multicultural teams, come join us!
  
  
**We provide advisory services encompassing:**

* Accounting, reporting and controlling process assessment and design including information systems implementation
* Finance process optimization and automation incl. Robotics Process Automation
* Accounting and regulatory support on accounting change in IFRS (IFRS conversion and implementation, new standards implementation)
* Financial consolidation
* Transactions accounting
* Audit readiness and audit remediation services
* Finance function strategic transformation
* Data analytics and visualization
* Investment Accounting, hedge accounting and derivative accounting
* Short term assignments to finance functions – accounting specialist, compliance specialist, consolidation specialist, controller etc.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities:**
**Collateral Management Operations**

* Lead end-to-end collateral management processes for OTC derivative portfolios across various asset classes.
* Provide oversight over exposure calculations and validate margin requirements in accordance with client methodologies and collateral agreements.
* Review and challenge collateral balances, margin movements and settlement information to lead ongoing collateral management activities.
* Oversee collateral eligibility, thresholds, minimum transfer amounts and other key agreement terms.
* Lead collateral call administration activities through preparation, validation and tracking of collateral requirements.
* Drive operational excellence, process standardization and automation initiatives.

**Reconciliations and Exception Management**

* Oversee reconciliations and exception management processes across counterparties and internal records.
* Manage escalation and resolution of collateral breaks, valuation differences, operational/ aged exceptions and collateral-related discrepancies.
* Monitor KPI/ KRI reporting, trackers, issue logs and exception reporting.

**CSA and Documentation Support**

* Review and interpret Credit Support Annex (CSA) provisions and provide guidance to document key collateral terms within operational processes.
* Lead collateral onboarding activities and operational readiness assessments.
* Maintain governance collateral reference data, procedures, SOPs and controls.

**Reporting, Controls and Governance**

* Manage collateral management reports, dashboards and management information packs.
* Monitoring of key risk indicators, operational metrics and service-level agreements.
* Establish and maintain relationships with client management and global stakeholders.
* Supervise engagement execution, planning, budgeting and resource management.

**Our Requirements:**

* 6-10 years of experience in Collateral Management, Treasury Operations, Derivatives Operations, Capital Markets Operations or Risk Operations.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in finance, complemented with a further relevant professional education (e.g. Chartered Accountant, CPA, CFA or ACCA)
* Experience supporting FX, derivatives, fixed income or money market products.
* Advanced Excel/Power BI skills/ data analytics - familiarity with data visualization and reconciliations.
* Strong knowledge of collateral management and OTC derivative operations.
* Good understanding of IFRS/US GAAP and International auditing standards.
* Knowledge of IFRS/ US GAAP for financial instruments
* Knowledge of ISDA and CSA documentation.
* Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and technical writing skills.
* Ability and comfort level in overseeing client inquires and emerging issues, including regulations, industry practices and new technologies.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Operation Head
description:
Job Description: Senior Project Manager / Operations Head – Interior Projects

Company: Opalspace

Position: Senior Project Manager / Operations Head – Interior Projects

Department: Operations

Location: Noida, Sector 63

Experience: 8–15 Years

Employment Type: Full-time

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Senior Project Manager / Operations Head to lead end-to-end interior project execution and operations. The role will be responsible for project delivery, site execution, production and vendor coordination, cost and margin control, quality, customer experience, payment collection, and operational efficiency. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in interior projects, preferably commercial interiors and/or large-scale interior execution, with the ability to lead multiple projects and teams, manage vendors and site operations, resolve execution bottlenecks, and deliver projects within committed timelines, budgets, quality standards, and customer expectations.

Key Responsibilities

• Own end-to-end project execution from project handover/initiation through installation, snag closure and final handover.

• Lead the overall operations function for assigned interior projects and ensure projects are delivered within committed timelines, approved budgets and defined quality standards.

• Plan project schedules, milestones, manpower, material requirements and execution priorities in coordination with design, procurement, production, vendors and site teams.

• Monitor project progress against agreed timelines and take immediate corrective action for delays, bottlenecks and dependencies.

• Track and monitor civil, carpentry, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, false ceiling, flooring, painting, furniture and other relevant interior execution activities as applicable to the project.

• Ensure timely vendor allocation, onboarding, mobilisation and deployment based on project requirements and schedules.

• Manage contractors, vendors, production teams, site supervisors and other execution partners; review performance and resolve operational issues.

• Coordinate with design and technical teams to ensure drawings, BOQs, specifications and site requirements are aligned before execution.

•
Monitor production progress, dispatches, installation and site readiness to ensure seamless movement from production to execution.

• Track project costs, material consumption, vendor costs, manpower costs, wastage, rework and other execution expenses.

• Ensure project profitability and contribution margins are maintained as per approved targets; identify and control cost leakages.

• Identify rework, quality issues, material wastage and execution deviations and implement preventive/corrective actions.

• Conduct regular site reviews and quality inspections and ensure snagging, rectification and closure before handover.

• Manage customer communication during execution, set expectations, resolve escalations and ensure a smooth handover experience.

• Drive customer satisfaction, including handover ratings, customer feedback and Google reviews wherever applicable.

• Monitor validation errors, execution deviations and other process gaps and ensure timely closure. • Manage project risks, dependencies and escalations and communicate critical issues to management with proposed solutions.

• Lead and mentor project/site teams, set clear responsibilities and monitor individual and team performance.

• Establish standard operating processes and improve project execution efficiency, productivity and turnaround time.

• Prepare and review project MIS, dashboards, project health reports, timelines, cost/margin reports and operational performance updates.

• Provide regular management updates on project status, revenue, collections, cost, margins, delays, quality concerns, risks and customer escalations.

• Drive payment collection achievement in coordination with sales/accounts as per project targets and agreed milestones.

• Ensure project documentation, approvals, handover documents, measurement records and closure documentation are completed on time.

• Support management in capacity planning, resource allocation, vendor strategy and operational decision-making.

Required Skills & Experience

• 8–15 years of relevant experience in interior design, commercial interiors, residential interiors, fitout, project execution or allied construction/interior operations.

• Strong experience managing end-to-end interior projects from execution through final handover.

• Experience leading multiple projects, project teams and site operations simultaneously.

• Strong understanding of civil work, interior fit-outs, production, installation, vendors, contractors and site operations.

• Strong understanding of project planning, scheduling, costing, budgeting and profitability.

• Demonstrated experience in vendor/contractor management and commercial negotiation.

• Strong customer and stakeholder management skills, including handling escalations.

• Strong leadership, planning, coordination, analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to read and understand project drawings, BOQs, specifications and execution requirements.

• Strong command of project MIS, Excel/Google Sheets and project management/reporting tools.

• Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

• Strong ownership, accountability and result-oriented approach.

• Willingness to travel to project sites as required. Preferred Profile

• Experience in commercial interior projects, corporate offices, retail, hospitality, turnkey fit-outs or large-scale residential interiors.

• Experience managing projects with multiple vendors and cross-functional teams.

• Experience in cost optimisation, project profitability and operational process improvement.

• Experience in managing project collections/payment milestones.

• Relevant qualification in Civil Engineering, Interior Design, Architecture, Construction Management, Project Management or a related field is preferred.

About Opalspace

Opalspace is a home interior design and execution company focused on transforming houses into beautifully designed, functional, and personalized homes. We offer end-to-end interior solutions, including full-home interiors, modular kitchens, wardrobes, furniture and décor, home renovation, interior painting, and smart home solutions. Our approach combines design, functionality, quality, technology, and seamless project execution. From understanding customer requirements and creating the design to production, installation, and final handover, Opalspace manages the complete project journey to deliver a smooth and reliable experience for homeowners.

title: Senior Manager – YouTube

Channel Operations, Team Leadership & Content Planning
  
  

* Own and oversee the daily operations of multiple YouTube channels (State PCS and other channels).
* Lead, mentor and manage the YouTube team, including YouTube managers/executives and content writers across all channels; set targets and review performance.
* Create and own content calendars and publishing schedules aligned to the PCS exam cycles (Prelims, Mains, Interview) and current affairs.

* Titles
* Descriptions
* Tags
* Keywords
* Thumbnails

* Watch hours

title: Sr Manager, Integrated Security Operations
description:
The Senior Manager, GSS India\- provides leadership and governance for ISOC and its expanding JAPAC support mandate, while strengthening regional incident readiness and business resilience. The role integrates security operations center governance, intelligence\-led monitoring, Incident Management Team (IMT) preparedness, incident coordination, Business Continuity Planning (BCP), and continuous improvement into a coherent operating model.
   

  

 This is a senior, critical leadership role with accountability for outcomes, readiness, governance, and cross\-functional coordination. Day\-to\-day monitoring and control room execution remain with the ISOC operational leadership and analyst teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* ISOC Leadership \& Governance
* Provide end\-to\-end leadership and governance for ISOC performance, service delivery, operating procedures, service


 levels, escalation protocols, quality, and risk controls.
   

  

* Guide the evolution of ISOC as a scalable, intelligence\-driven regional hub supporting India and JAPAC.
* Ensure effective 24x7 monitoring, triage, notification, escalation, incident documentation, and employee assistance support.
* Establish meaningful performance indicators, trend analysis, assurance reviews, and leadership reporting.
* Drive process standardization, technology enablement, automation, workforce capability, and continuous improvement in


 partnership with GSS Technology and Systems.
   

  

* JAPAC Regional Support
* Lead the operational readiness and phased expansion of ISOC support for JAPAC, including service scope, coverage,


 handoffs, escalation pathways, and regional operating protocols.
   

  

* Work closely with the Regional Director, JAPAC, regional GSS leaders, and in\-country stakeholders to align ISOC support


 with regional priorities and global GSS standards.
   

  

* Promote consistent regional situational awareness, risk monitoring, incident visibility, and timely escalation across


 supported markets.
   

  

* Ensure ISOC regional support complements, and does not replace, local response ownership and country\-specific


 requirements.
   

  

* Incident Management Team Readiness \& Coordination
* Support the Regional GSS Lead in maintaining IMT readiness, governance, rosters, activation protocols, escalation criteria,


 and supporting documentation.
   

  

* Coordinate IMT preparedness activities, including periodic touchpoints, tabletop exercises, simulations, training, and


 lessons\-learned reviews.
   

  

* Enable effective incident coordination through timely situational awareness, action tracking, Emergency Notification System support, meeting records, and stakeholder updates.
* Support After\-Action Reviews and track corrective and preventive actions to closure.
* Maintain alignment among the regional IMT, local Emergency Response Teams (ERTs), the Corporate Crisis Management


 Team (CMT), GSOC, and ISOC.
   

  

* Business Continuity \& Operational Resilience
* Coordinate GSS India Business Continuity Planning requirements in alignment with 1\-Adobe Enterprise Resilience (1\-AER),


 enterprise BCP processes, and applicable Site Recovery Plans.
   

  

* Partner with business and functional stakeholders on Business Impact Analyses (BIAs), continuity plans, recovery priorities,


 and testing or assurance activities.
   

  

 Global Safety \& Security \| Job Description \| Confidential
   

  

* Connect BCP, incident management, emergency response, and site recovery arrangements to support a coordinated


 response and recovery model.
   

  

* Maintain current, controlled, and audit\-ready documentation, with clear ownership and remediation tracking.
* Identify resilience gaps, dependencies, and improvement opportunities and provide transparent reporting to leadership.
* Cross\-Functional Partnership
* Work as an integrated partner with India Security Operations, Security Systems \& Technology, and Environmental Health \&


 Safety / Safety leadership to ensure coordinated delivery across people, places, and technology.
   

  

* Partner with Site Operations and Safety teams during incidents, exercises, recovery activities, and operational readiness


 reviews.
   

  

* Build effective relationships with regional GSS leaders, Employee Experience, Employee Communications, Legal,


 Corporate Risk, Adobe Technology Services, Global Site Operations, Travel, and other subject matter experts.
   

  

* Clarify roles, decision rights, handoffs, and escalation paths across partner functions to prevent duplication and strengthen


 accountability.
   

  

* Governance, Reporting \& Improvement
* Prepare concise executive briefings, dashboards, decision papers, and incident or resilience updates for India and regional


 leadership.
   

  

* Maintain SOPs, playbooks, control documentation, action trackers, and governance rhythms for the role portfolio.
* Use operational data, incident trends, exercise findings, and stakeholder feedback to prioritize improvements and


 investment needs.
   

  

* Support budget planning, supplier governance, workforce planning, audit actions, and capability development relevant to


 ISOC and resilience.
   

  

 Key Working Relationships
   

  

* Internal: Director, India Safety \& Security; India Security Operations Lead; Security Systems \& Technology Lead;


 Environmental Health \& Safety / Safety Lead; ISOC operational leadership and analysts.
   

  

* Regional: Regional Director, JAPAC; country and regional GSS leaders; GSOC; relevant JAPAC stakeholders.
* Cross\-functional: Global Site Operations, Employee Experience, Employee Communications, Legal, Corporate Risk, Adobe


 Technology Services, Travel, Enterprise Resilience, and other IMT members.
   

  

* External: Service providers and suppliers supporting ISOC, risk monitoring, emergency notification, continuity, and


 specialist response capabilities.
   

  

**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience; professional certifications in security, incident


 management, emergency management, or business continuity are preferred.
   

  

* Progressive experience in security operations, security operations center leadership, incident or crisis management,


 business continuity, resilience, or a related discipline.
   

  

* Demonstrated experience leading or governing a SOC, GSOC, ISOC, or comparable 24x7 operational environment.
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional incident response, exercises, After\-Action Reviews, and corrective action programs.
* Experience working across multiple countries, cultures, or time zones, preferably within JAPAC.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and governance capabilities.
* Credential such as CPP, CBCP, ISO 22301 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CEM, MBCI, ICS Certifications, will be an added


 advantge
   

  

 Core Capabilities
   

  

* Operational leadership and disciplined execution
* Incident command support and decision\-making under pressure
* Business continuity and operational resilience
* Intelligence\-led monitoring, risk assessment, and trend analysis
* Executive communication and stakeholder influence
* Cross\-functional collaboration without reliance on direct authority
* Process improvement, technology enablement, and change leadership
* High standards of integrity, confidentiality, accountability, and duty of care


 Measures of Success
   

  

* ISOC service reliability, escalation quality, response timeliness, and stakeholder confidence.
* Effective and sustainable expansion of ISOC support across JAPAC.
* IMT readiness demonstrated through current rosters, training, exercises, activation support, and action closure.


 Global Safety \& Security \| Job Description \| Confidential
   

  

* Improved alignment among ISOC, India Security Operations, Systems \& Technology, Safety, and regional GSS leadership.
* Current and tested continuity and recovery arrangements for in\-scope GSS functions and sites.
* Clear, timely, decision\-useful reporting on incidents, risk trends, readiness, and improvement priorities.
* Sustained closure of audit, exercise, incident, and resilience improvement actions.

* Collaborates with the division lead to identify and address performance improvement needs.

* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.

* Exceptional problem\-solving abilities.

description:

**Service line \- Position Title: Consulting \- SAP TRM Manager**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 EY Consulting is a fast\-moving, high\-growth area with huge potential. We are currently recruiting for a Seniors to join our team. This team offers variety, challenge, responsibility and the opportunity to realize your leadership potential. Being a member of our Consulting team means you will specialize in a particular competency \- Risk, Technology Consulting, or IT Risk \& Assurance. Our Technology Consulting team is focused on helping clients improve operational efficiency and security, while also reducing costs and managing risk.
   

  

 In this role, we are looking for an experienced SAP TRM Manager to join our growing SAP Finance team. As an SAP Treasury and Risk Management (TRM) Manager you will oversee the design, implementation, and optimization of SAP S/4HANA treasury solutions, focusing on cash management, transaction management, and risk analysis. They lead teams, manage stakeholder relationships, map business processes, and ensure regulatory compliance for treasury operations.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Conduct Business Blueprint design workshops to gather requirements and understand the client's business processes.
* Lead end\-to\-end SAP TRM implementations, including Blueprinting, Configuration, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
* Optimize cash management, liquidity planning, bank communication, and hedge accounting.
* Utilize Market Risk Analyzer and Credit Risk Analyzer to mitigate financial risks.
* Prepare functional gaps analysis by identifying areas where standard SAP S4 HANA TRM functionalities need enhancements or customization
* Handle complex enhancements in TRM requirements, ensuring the solution aligns with the client's business requirements.
* Provide guidance and support to end\-users during testing, training, and post\-go\-live phases.
* Completion of assigned tasks on time and regular status reporting to the senior manager.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also**
* You’ll build and nurture positive working relationships with teams and clients with the intention to exceed client expectations.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyse business requirements independently (Mandatory skill)
* Ability to drive design workshops independently with the client (Mandatory skill)
* Must be able to prepare the materials for the design workshops independently (Mandatory skill)
* Must send out the Meeting Minutes of the Workshop post each workshop that he/she leads (Mandatory skill)

 10\+ years

 EduCrypt — EdTech SaaS Platform

 We are looking for an experienced
 **"Technical Project Manager / Delivery Manager"** 
 to own end\-to\-end delivery for EduCrypt, our EdTech SaaS platform. The role requires someone who is equally comfortable in sprint rooms and in architecture discussions — driving planning and execution across a large, cross\-functional development team while staying hands\-on enough to understand infrastructure, code, and quality risks well enough to challenge them.
 



  





**Key Qualifications** 



* **10\+ years of experience in technical project / delivery management, including at least one stint managing a large development team.**

* **Working understanding of Node.js / Nest.js — able to read code, review PRs at a conceptual level, and reason about API and service design.**

* Having good understanding of Android, iOS and Web development.
* Solid grounding in both manual and automation testing, and hands\-on experience building test plans and QA strategy.
* Understanding of application security and VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment \& Penetration Testing) — able to interpret findings, prioritize remediation, and track closure.
* Demonstrated capability managing all development team across multiple pods/squads.
* Strong track record in sprint planning and execution — backlog grooming, estimation, velocity tracking, and release management.
* Excellent communication skills — able to translate between engineering, QA, security, and business stakeholders.
* Direct exposure to AI\-assisted development — using AI tools to write, review, or accelerate code, and comfort evaluating AI\-generated output.
* Familiarity with AI workflows — prompt\-driven development processes, AI\-in\-the\-loop QA/documentation, and evaluating where AI fits into the delivery pipeline.
* **1–2 products' worth of ownership experience, with 3\+ years on at least one product from a similar stage (SaaS / EdTech preferred).**



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Own delivery planning, sprint execution, and release tracking across the EduCrypt engineering team.**
* Translate product requirements into technical documentation, test plans, and execution\-ready tickets.
* Coordinate manual and automation QA efforts; review test coverage and sign off on release readiness.
* Track and triage production issues; drive root\-cause analysis and ensure timely resolution and feedback loops.
* Partner with security/VAPT vendors or internal teams to track vulnerability remediation.
* Monitor AWS infrastructure health and costs in coordination with DevOps, flagging risks early.
* Produce regular status reports, delivery dashboards, and data\-driven insights for leadership.
* **Champion the use of AI tools within the team to improve coding velocity, QA, and documentation quality.**
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and release/deployment governance (change management, rollback planning).
* Familiarity with EdTech\-specific concerns: DRM/content protection (e.g., Widevine/HLS), payment gateway integrations, and data privacy for student data.
* Exposure to Agile scaling frameworks (e.g., SAFe, Scrum\-of\-Scrums) given the 40\+ team size.
* Basic financial/commercial literacy (budget tracking, P\&L or delivery\-cost accountability).

title: Commissiong Manager HVDC
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 The HVDC Construction and Commissioning Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and leading all site construction, installation, testing, and commissioning activities for High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) projects. This role ensures that project execution is delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with technical specifications, quality standards, and contractual requirements.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Construction Management
   

  

* Support on\-site construction activities for HVDC converter stations, substations, cable systems, and associated infrastructure with primary responsibility of managing commissioning.
* Coordinate site managers, subcontractors, and suppliers to achieve commissioning milestones.
* Oversee installation of major equipment such as converters, transformers, valves, reactors, GIS/AIS equipment, cooling systems, and control/protection systems.


 Technical Leadership
   

  

* Oversee commissioning of HVDC converter systems, transformers, valves, switchgear, smoothing reactors, cooling systems, AC/DC yard equipment, and control/protection systems.
* Lead troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis for issues encountered during testing and energization.
* Ensure technical compliance with design documents, grid code requirements, contractual specifications, and industry standards.
* Support engineering teams in resolving design changes, non\-conformances, and site technical queries.


 Commissioning Management
   

  

* Plan and manage pre\-commissioning, commissioning, energization, and performance testing activities for HVDC systems.
* Coordinate system integration and interface testing between electrical, control, protection, telecom, and SCADA systems.
* Ensure commissioning procedures, test protocols, and acceptance criteria are developed, reviewed, and approved.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of technical issues during testing and energization.
* Support handover of commissioned systems to the client and operations team.


 Environment, Health, \& Safety (EHS) and Quality
   

  

* Promote and enforce a strong safety culture across all site activities.
* Ensure compliance with EHS regulations, permit\-to\-work systems, lockout/tagout procedures, and project\-specific safety requirements.
* Ensure all construction and commissioning work meets applicable quality standards, codes, and contractual obligations.


 Stakeholder Coordination and Reporting
   

  

* Serve as the main point of contact for commissioning\-related matters with the client, project management, OEMs, and grid operators.
* Participate in progress reviews, readiness assessments, and milestone meetings.
* Report commissioning progress, issues, risks, and recovery plans to project leadership.
* Support final acceptance testing, handover, and project closeout activities.


 Documentation and Compliance
   

  

* Ensure site documentation is complete and up to date, including inspection records, test reports, punch lists, and as\-built documentation.
* Verify compliance with grid codes, customer specifications, and applicable international standards.
* Support factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), and final project documentation closure.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Extensive experience in HVDC, substations, power transmission, or large utility\-scale electrical infrastructure projects.
* Strong experience in both construction management and commissioning of high\-voltage electrical systems.
* Proven knowledge of converter stations, protection and control systems, testing procedures, and energization processes.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience managing large, complex EPC or turnkey HVDC projects.
* Knowledge of LCC and/or VSC HVDC technologies.
* Experience working with multinational teams, contractors, and clients across multiple geographies.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and commissioning procedures.


 Typical Experience Profile
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in power transmission, substation, or HVDC projects
* 5\+ years in a site leadership, construction management, or commissioning leadership role
* Demonstrated experience with high\-voltage equipment installation, testing, and energization


 Working Conditions
   

  

* Site based role
* Work may involve remote project locations, outage windows, and high\-pressure commissioning periods
* Availability for field troubleshooting and critical milestone support is necessary


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes

title: MS Dynamics NAV ERP Head
description:

 Metaflex Doors is a leading provider of high\-tech airtight and hermetic door systems serving global healthcare, cold chain, and life science markets. With over 50 years of experience, Metaflex is recognized worldwide for safety, reliability, and sustainable solutions that protect critical environments.
