title: Commissioning Manager HVDC
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Job Description Summary
   

  

 The HVDC Construction and Commissioning Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and leading all site construction, installation, testing, and commissioning activities for High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) projects. This role ensures that project execution is delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with technical specifications, quality standards, and contractual requirements.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Construction Management
   

  

* Support on\-site construction activities for HVDC converter stations, substations, cable systems, and associated infrastructure with primary responsibility of managing commissioning.
* Coordinate site managers, subcontractors, and suppliers to achieve commissioning milestones.
* Oversee installation of major equipment such as converters, transformers, valves, reactors, GIS/AIS equipment, cooling systems, and control/protection systems.


 Technical Leadership
   

  

* Oversee commissioning of HVDC converter systems, transformers, valves, switchgear, smoothing reactors, cooling systems, AC/DC yard equipment, and control/protection systems.
* Lead troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis for issues encountered during testing and energization.
* Ensure technical compliance with design documents, grid code requirements, contractual specifications, and industry standards.
* Support engineering teams in resolving design changes, non\-conformances, and site technical queries.


 Commissioning Management
   

  

* Plan and manage pre\-commissioning, commissioning, energization, and performance testing activities for HVDC systems.
* Coordinate system integration and interface testing between electrical, control, protection, telecom, and SCADA systems.
* Ensure commissioning procedures, test protocols, and acceptance criteria are developed, reviewed, and approved.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of technical issues during testing and energization.
* Support handover of commissioned systems to the client and operations team.


 Environment, Health, \& Safety (EHS) and Quality
   

  

* Promote and enforce a strong safety culture across all site activities.
* Ensure compliance with EHS regulations, permit\-to\-work systems, lockout/tagout procedures, and project\-specific safety requirements.
* Ensure all construction and commissioning work meets applicable quality standards, codes, and contractual obligations.


 Stakeholder Coordination and Reporting
   

  

* Serve as the main point of contact for commissioning\-related matters with the client, project management, OEMs, and grid operators.
* Participate in progress reviews, readiness assessments, and milestone meetings.
* Report commissioning progress, issues, risks, and recovery plans to project leadership.
* Support final acceptance testing, handover, and project closeout activities.


 Documentation and Compliance
   

  

* Ensure site documentation is complete and up to date, including inspection records, test reports, punch lists, and as\-built documentation.
* Verify compliance with grid codes, customer specifications, and applicable international standards.
* Support factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), and final project documentation closure.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Extensive experience in HVDC, substations, power transmission, or large utility\-scale electrical infrastructure projects.
* Strong experience in both construction management and commissioning of high\-voltage electrical systems.
* Proven knowledge of converter stations, protection and control systems, testing procedures, and energization processes.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience managing large, complex EPC or turnkey HVDC projects.
* Knowledge of LCC and/or VSC HVDC technologies.
* Experience working with multinational teams, contractors, and clients across multiple geographies.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and commissioning procedures.


 Typical Experience Profile
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in power transmission, substation, or HVDC projects
* 5\+ years in a site leadership, construction management, or commissioning leadership role
* Demonstrated experience with high\-voltage equipment installation, testing, and energization


 Working Conditions
   

  

* Site based role
* Work may involve remote project locations, outage windows, and high\-pressure commissioning periods
* Availability for field troubleshooting and critical milestone support is necessary

Title:\- EPR – E\-Waste \& Battery Operations Manager
 



 Location: \- Noida

**Job Purpose** 




 Own end\-to\-end operational execution of Attero's EPR (Extended Producer Responsibility) and IPR obligations for e\-waste and lithium\-ion battery categories — covering CPCB portal compliance, IPR coordination for imported\-product obligations, collection network management, EPR certificate reconciliation, and audit readiness.

 • Manage CPCB portal registration, target mapping, and return filing for e\-waste and battery EPR obligations.
 



 • Coordinate IPR compliance for producers/brand owners routing obligations through import channels — including import documentation alignment, IPR target tracking, and liaison with customs/import\-compliance stakeholders where applicable.
 



 • Plan and monitor e\-waste and battery collection operations to meet EPR/IPR targets committed to clients and CPCB.
 



 • Manage EPR certificate generation, allocation to clients, and reconciliation against processed tonnage.
 



 • Onboard and audit collection agents, aggregators, and pre\-processing vendors for compliance and SLA adherence.
 



 • Maintain audit\-ready documentation (load lists, weighbridge slips, chain\-of\-custody, IPR/import records) for CPCB and client audits.
 



 • Provide accurate MIS/dashboards on collection status, EPR/IPR liability fulfilment, and portal data to BD, KAM, and management.
 



 • Escalate regulatory risk, vendor non\-compliance, or target shortfalls to BD leadership in a timely manner.
 



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




 • Bachelor's degree in engineering, Environmental Science, Supply Chain, or related field; MBA preferred.
 



 • 5–8 years in e\-waste/battery recycling operations, EPR/IPR compliance, or environmental regulatory affairs.
 



 • Working knowledge of E\-Waste (Management) Rules, Battery Waste Management Rules, CPCB EPR/IPR portal processes, and import\-linked producer obligations.
 



  





 Key Skills
 



 • Regulatory and process orientation; CPCB/IPR portal fluency.
 



 • Vendor management and MIS/dashboard reporting.
 



 • Cross\-functional coordination with BD, KAM, logistics, and plant operations.

title: Senior Lead, Information Technology (IT) and System Support
description:
Are you a change maker who wants to play a pivotal role in restoring vision for millions of people in low\-income settings across India? Would you like to work for an organisation that is a pioneer in social impact practices?
 





 We are seeking a highly motivated, dynamic, and self\-driven candidate who would like to have a challenging and meaningful career path in information technology and the social sector. Information Technology (IT) is a key focus area in our organisation and requires a proactive and dynamic approach. The candidate should be dedicated and sincere towards her/his work and should always be open to learning new things. The candidate should have in\-depth subject matter knowledge, expertise, and experience. Timely and high\-quality delivery of goals would be essential and will be a key performance measurement criterion. S/he will be based out of Delhi NCR (Noida), India.
 




  





**About You**

* You love to start, run, and complete projects, no matter how big or small.
* You are excited to demonstrate your projects.
* You enjoy problem solving that requires research and development.
* You like to manage technology projects of any nature.




  
 




**About Us**

* As a social organisation, social change motivates us first. Our focus is on advancing our mission objectives \- to increase functioning, productivity, and income earning potential for our low\-income people by correcting impaired vision with eyeglasses.
* We are working to transform the systemic dysfunction which has failed to deliver eyeglasses \- a 700\-year\-old technology \- to approximately 55 Crore people in India in need of vision correction.
* We serve low\-income people who are more than beneficiaries to us. The people (and the partners) we serve expect high\-quality eye\-screening and eyeglasses.
* To efficiently scale, we must deliver each new unit at less cost.
* We run our operations on financial metrics and social impact measures. We leverage a range of processes and practices to get the work done.
* We believe in scaling our impact, not our organisation. We are a lean team of doers.



  





**What You’ll Do** 





 You will be leading the IT department and the talented individuals that are part of the same. You will be responsible for providing management for the development and release of internal and external software projects and the management of system support and infrastructure operations. If you work well in an energising environment, have excellent communication, superb administrative and technical skills, can multi\-task under pressure, and are self\-motivated…we want you!
 




  





**Essential Functions** 



* Managing IT operations teams for internal system support and Azure cloud/LAN infrastructure.
* Planning and implementing projects ensuring timely and accurate communication and distribution of information, documentation, and issue resolution to all appropriate team members.
* Leading, facilitating, and tracking project deliverables using Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
* Overseeing QA/QC testing, user acceptance/adoption, and tools research and selection.
* Strong hands\-on experience in cybersecurity tools, risk mitigation, and compliance.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL framework.
* Administer and manage SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Microsoft 365 suite.
* Develop intranet portals, document management system, workflows (Power Automate), and permissions architecture.
* Manage SharePoint security, data retention policies, and integration with other work/operational apps.
* Drive user adoption and training for SharePoint and Teams.
* Budgeting, vendor management, license compliance, and IT asset management.
* Maintain IT documentation, SOPs, and IT risk register
* Providing program insights efficiently.
* Working with teams across multiple locations.
* Overseeing the programming team.
* Experiencing managing software development projects.



  





**What’s Required** 



* 15\+ years’ experience in IT operations and software product development.
* Fluent in reading, writing, and speaking English
* Experience in feature release planning, product charter, scope definition, requirements gathering, project planning, change control, risk management, and reporting.
* Ability to break down the requirements into user stories and can run the stories with the organisation to define the prioritisation.
* At least 3 years’ project management experience using Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
* Experience working with SAP B1 and Salesforce.
* Experience managing a website.
* Experience with the integration between various systems.
* Experience of working on multiple projects simultaneously.
* Ability to translate organisational requirements to technical documentation and artifacts.
* Ability to wireframe and prototype solutions.
* Strong understanding of SDLC and its phases.
* Ability to interact with users and translate needs maintainable configurations, extensions and customisations.
* Ability to set up source code management/release platform (GitHub)
* Ability to set up automated QC/QA testing.
* Experiencing managing IT teams.
* Experience with Zoho Sprint a plus.
* Working experience in database programming using RDBMS databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, others, etc.
* Exposure to Microsoft IIS.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure is a plus.
* Extraordinary follow\-through, attention to detail and deadlines, and a strong personal sense of accountability.
* The highest standards of ethics, with a demonstrated capacity for discretion and for handling sensitive information with care.
* Meaningful experience working as a part of a team and demonstrated success collaborating with external consultants to move projects forward.
* Quick learner and self\-driven.



  





**Compensation and Benefits** 



* Salary based on experience and education.
* Competitive benefits, including health insurance and generous vacation time.



  





**To Apply** 



* We want to know more than just what you have done. We want to know who you are. What are the passions and talents that draw you to this role?
* Please submit an application, including a thoughtful cover letter and your CV/resume, to:
 
 careers@visionspringfoundation.org
 
 . Please ensure there is a short description of each organisation on your CV/resume. Include your last name and “Senior Lead, Information Technology (IT) and System Support” in the subject line.

title: Head of Buying & Merchandising – Footwear
description:
**Company:** 
 Morphstar Studio Private Limited
 



**Engagement:** 
 Fractional / Project\-Based
 



**Industry:** 
 Fashion \& Footwear
 



**Location:** 
 India \| Remote/Hybrid
   




 About Morphstar
 
 Morphstar Studio is an early\-stage footwear startup building a new category of adaptable women’s footwear.
 



 Our first product is a
 **foldable heel that can transition from a heel to a flatter, more comfortable form** 
 , allowing women to move between style and comfort without changing their shoes.
 



 We have a working prototype and are now moving towards commercial manufacturing and our first market launch.
 



 As a new brand with no historical sales data, one of the most important decisions we need to make is
 **what our first commercial assortment should look like and how much inventory we should commit to it.** 




 We are looking for an experienced
 **Fractional Head of Buying \& Merchandising** 
 to work directly with the founder and help us make these decisions.
   




 What We Need Help With
 
 We are looking for someone who can help us answer questions such as:
 


* How many styles should we launch with?
* How many colours should we offer per style?
* Which colours should form the initial assortment?
* What should our size curve look like?
* How many units should we manufacture per SKU?
* How should we balance assortment breadth vs inventory depth?
* Which products should receive deeper inventory?
* What should our total initial buy look like?
* How should MOQs and manufacturing lead times influence our assortment?
* How much inventory risk should a new brand take at launch?
* What should our replenishment and reorder strategy look like?
* How should pricing, margins and commercial viability influence the range?



 The goal is to leave the engagement with a
 **clear, commercially thought\-through launch assortment and buying plan** 
 , rather than making these decisions based purely on instinct.
   




 What You Would Work On
 
 The engagement would broadly involve:
 



**Assortment Strategy** 




 Recommend the number of styles, colours, sizes and overall SKU architecture for our first launch.
 



**Range Planning** 




 Help structure the collection across hero products, colours, price points and customer needs.
 



**Size Curve Planning** 




 Recommend initial size ratios and quantities, particularly given that we do not yet have historical sales data.
 



**Initial Buy Planning** 




 Recommend units per SKU and total launch inventory while balancing customer choice, MOQs, available capital and dead\-stock risk.
 



**Inventory Depth vs Breadth** 




 Help us determine where we should offer variety and where we should concentrate inventory.
 



**Demand \& Scenario Planning** 




 Build assumptions for a conservative, base and stronger\-than\-expected launch and recommend how inventory should be approached under each.
 



**Replenishment Strategy** 




 Define reorder points, inventory buffers and an approach for replenishing winning SKUs while limiting exposure to slow\-moving products.
 



**Commercial Input** 




 Work alongside the founder and finance team to ensure assortment decisions make sense in the context of product cost, pricing, margins and working capital.
   




 Who We're Looking For
 
 We are specifically looking for someone with strong hands\-on experience in:
 


* **Footwear buying and merchandising**
* Women's footwear preferred
* Range and assortment planning
* Merchandise planning
* Inventory and buy planning
* Size\-level planning
* Category management
* Pricing and margin thinking
* Working with manufacturers and MOQs



 Experience at a leading
 **footwear, fashion, D2C, retail or e\-commerce brand** 
 would be highly relevant.
 



 We would particularly value someone who has experience
 **launching a new brand, category or product range without relying entirely on historical sales data.** 




 This is a
 **senior strategic role** 
 . We are not looking for a production merchandiser whose primary responsibility is factory coordination, sampling or order follow\-ups.
   




 Engagement Structure
 
 This is a
 **fractional / project\-based engagement** 
 , not a full\-time position.
 



 You would work closely with the founder during the pre\-launch period to help us make our initial assortment and inventory decisions and establish a merchandising framework that we can continue using after launch.
 



 The exact scope, duration and time commitment can be structured based on your recommended approach.
   




 To Apply
 
 Please share your profile along with a short note covering:
 


1. Your experience in footwear/fashion buying and merchandising
2. Brands or categories you have worked with
3. Whether you have experience creating an initial assortment without historical sales data
4. How you would broadly approach building the first buy for a new footwear brand
5. Your availability and expected commercials for a fractional/project engagement



 If you know someone who has spent years making
 **real buying, range and inventory decisions in footwear** 
 , we'd love an introduction.

title: Manager - Customer Service Transformation And AI

title: Senior Manager/AVP – US Bookkeeping
description:
**The Opportunity** 





 Qualicentric runs an established US bookkeeping and accounting delivery practice — a team of roughly ten accountants handling bookkeeping, month\-end close, and reporting for US small and mid\-market clients. The practice works, and now we want to level it up: tighten the operating engine, raise the quality bar, and build the structure to scale it several times over.
 





 We are also moving the wider firm toward an outcome\-based, fixed\-fee model powered by automation and AI — a shift away from the headcount\-based offshore norm. This role sits at the centre of both: stabilise and strengthen what exists today, then build the bigger, smarter practice of tomorrow.
 




  





**Who We're Looking For** 





 Someone who has personally run a comparable US bookkeeping / accounting delivery practice in a KPO or outsourcing environment — not just managed a team, but owned the quality, economics, and growth of a book of US clients. You bring deep, hands\-on US accounting expertise, the operational instinct to run a tight delivery engine, and the leadership to build one that scales.
 





 Four things matter most in this role: strong communication and client presence, sharp accounting fundamentals, an uncompromising quality bar, and the flexibility to adapt across clients, priorities, and US time zones. If those are your strengths, this is a role you will thrive in.
 




  





**What You'll Own** 




  





**Delivery \& Quality** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery for the US bookkeeping \& accounting book — quality, accuracy, timeliness, and SLA adherence across bookkeeping, month\-end close, and reporting.
* Run delivery governance: capacity planning, resource allocation, utilization, WIP, and quality reviews, with clear performance metrics.
* Surface and resolve delivery risks, dependencies, and scope issues early — maintaining a zero\-surprise culture with clients and internally.
* Own the practice's operational economics — utilization, realization, and profitability, not just output.



  





**Team Leadership** 



* Lead, mentor, and develop the accounting team — accountants, seniors, and managers — setting clear expectations and holding accountability for outcomes.
* Build leadership depth and succession by growing managers into owners, and close capability gaps through targeted coaching and training.
* Design the team structure and hiring plan to scale the practice as the client base grows.



  





**Client Partnership** 



* Work closely with clients day to day — interacting regularly, building trust, and taking complete, end\-to\-end ownership of every deliverable.
* Support clients on the FP\&A and strategy side — budgeting, forecasting, and the analysis that shapes their business decisions — not just the books.
* Partner with clients as a trusted advisor, presenting month\-end results, cash flow, and operational insight in clear, confident communication.
* Act as the senior escalation point for complex delivery and accounting matters, with proactive updates on risks, delays, and corrective actions.
* Partner with Business Development on onboarding, solutioning, account expansion, and cross\-sell.



  





**Process, Technology \& AI** 



* Standardise SOPs, quality controls, and delivery processes across accounts so quality is repeatable, not personality\-dependent.
* Champion automation, AI\-enabled workflows, and data\-driven dashboards to lift efficiency, quality, and client experience.
* Help drive the firm's transition to an outcome\-based delivery model.



  





**Qualifications** 

  
 



* 10\+ years in Finance \& Accounting, with 4–5\+ years leading teams — ideally in outsourcing, KPO, or a CA/CPA environment.
* Proven track record running a US F\&A delivery practice: leading delivery teams, driving operational excellence, and building scalable functions in a client\-facing setting.
* Strong US GAAP knowledge across month\-end close, bookkeeping, financial reporting, AP/AR, and FP\&A.
* Excellent written and verbal business English, with the communication skills and presence to hold senior client relationships directly.
* An uncompromising eye for quality and accuracy, paired with the flexibility to adapt across clients, shifting priorities, and US time zones.
* Comfort supporting clients beyond the books — on FP\&A, budgeting, forecasting, and the strategy conversations that come with them.
* CA, CPA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent preferred.
* Hands\-on with QuickBooks, Xero, Bill.com, Ramp, or similar; exposure to AI/automation in accounting is a strong plus.



  





**What We Offer** 

  
 





 This is structured as an operator's role with an owner's upside. We want the person who runs this practice to think — and be rewarded — like a builder, not a caretaker.
 



* A competitive fixed salary, benchmarked to senior F\&A outsourcing roles.
* Performance\-linked upside tied to the practice's profitability — you share directly in the margin you help grow.
* A share of the new business you bring in, rewarding origination on top of delivery.
* A defined path to partner — this role is built to grow into an ownership stake in the practice as you deliver against clear milestones.
* Real ownership from day one — the mandate to build and scale, with direct visibility to the founders.
* Direct exposure to US clients, complex F\&A engagements, and a front\-row seat in the AI\-driven transformation of the industry.

title: GM/AVP- Employee Relations and Retention
description:
Role Summary
 
 ICCS is looking for a General Manager / AVP – Employee Relations \& Retention to own attrition as a business number across ICCS's approximately 5,000\-employee, 10\+ site PAN India footprint, and to run the compliance\-first ER case function that supports it. In a domestic BPO, attrition is the single largest controllable cost driver — this role exists to move that number, not merely to administer grievance and disciplinary process around it. It is for a seasoned ER / attrition leader who has run a high\-volume ER function inside a BPO / ITES / contact\-centre environment — grievance handling, disciplinary process and domestic enquiries, POSH compliance — and has personally owned and moved an attrition number at scale.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
**1\. Attrition Ownership \& Retention Strategy** 




 •    Own the PAN India attrition target; publish and defend attrition performance to the CEO's office monthly.
 



 •    Design and run retention programmes targeted at the 0–90 day window, where most frontline attrition occurs.
 



 •    Build exit analytics — reason codes, tenure cohorts, site and process\-level patterns — and convert them into operational interventions, not just engagement activity.
 



 •    Partner with Operations leadership so retention actions land with team leaders, not only with HR.
 



**2\. PAN India ER Strategy \& Governance** 




 •    Own the ER framework end\-to\-end for all ICCS centres (Noida, Mumbai, Bangalore, Chennai and any new sites), ensuring consistent grievance redressal, disciplinary process and investigation protocols.
 



 •    Own ER case TAT and SLA commitments against every open case, and personally intervene on high\-risk or aging matters.
 



 •    Build and standardise ER policies, SOPs and escalation matrices consistently across all sites and processes.
 



**3\. Grievance Handling \& Investigations** 




 •    Lead or oversee investigations into employee complaints — misconduct, harassment, policy violations — ensuring principles of natural justice are followed throughout.
 



 •    Conduct or supervise disciplinary hearings and domestic enquiries, working closely with site HR and Operations.
 



 •    Ensure fair, prompt and confidential handling of every case, with documentation that stands up to audit and legal scrutiny.
 



**4\. Statutory Compliance \& POSH** 




 •    Own POSH compliance PAN India — constitution and functioning of Internal Committees (IC) at every location, awareness sessions, and timely closure of complaints within statutory timelines.
 



 •    Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws — Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, Shops \& Establishments Act, Contract Labour Act, and other state\-specific regulations across all centres.
 



 •    Liaise with legal counsel on ER matters that carry litigation or regulatory risk.
 



**5\. Employee Engagement \& Listening** 




 •    Run skip\-level connects, engagement surveys and floor\-level listening mechanisms, particularly at frontline/production level.
 



 •    Analyse exit interview and case data to identify ER\-linked attrition drivers and recommend systemic fixes to Operations and HR leadership.
 



**6\. Stakeholder \& Team Management** 




 •    Manage works/grievance committees as required under Standing Orders, and act as the primary liaison between employees, Operations leadership and HR on sensitive matters.
 



 •    Partner closely with Operations, Legal and Compliance teams on high\-risk or reputationally sensitive cases.
 



 •    Build, mentor and manage a PAN India ER team of 8–10 across locations — setting case\-quality, TAT and attrition\-outcome standards.
 



**7\. Reporting \& Governance** 




 •    Own the ER and attrition dashboard and report monthly on attrition performance, case volumes, TAT, closure rates and POSH compliance status to the CEO's office and Head – HR.
 



 •    Maintain complete case documentation and ensure audit\-readiness across all centres at all times.
 



  




 Desired Candidate Profile
 
**Experience \& Background** 




 •    15\+ years in Employee Relations / Industrial Relations, with direct ownership of an attrition number — not case management alone.
 



 •    Has owned an attrition number across a workforce of 3,000 or more in a BPO or similar high\-churn environment, with a measurable, personally\-driven reduction backed by before\-and\-after figures.
 



 •    Mandatory: current or recent experience within the BPO / ITES / Contact Centre / Shared Services industry, with direct ER exposure in a high\-volume, frontline environment.
 



 •    Managed a PAN India, multi\-location ER team of 8 or more (minimum 3–4 locations), ideally including Noida/Delhi\-NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru and Chennai.
 



 •    Hands\-on experience conducting domestic enquiries and POSH investigations, from complaint intake through to closure.
 



 •    Working knowledge of applicable labour laws — Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, Shops \& Establishments Act, POSH Act, Contract Labour Act and related state regulations, including contract labour compliance.
 



 •    Experience partnering with Legal and Operations leadership on high\-risk or litigation\-prone cases.
 



**Preferred** 




 •    Experience in a unionised or union\-attempt environment.
 



 •    Exposure to predictive attrition analytics.
 



**Not a Fit** 




 •    Generalist HRBPs who have supported attrition initiatives without owning the number.
 



 •    Corporate or white\-collar ER backgrounds with no frontline, high\-churn exposure.
 



 •    Candidates who describe retention purely as engagement activity — events, celebrations, rewards — with no analytical basis.
 



**Education** 




 •    Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR preferred.
 



**Key Skills \& Competencies** 




 •    Ownership of an attrition number as a business metric, backed by data.
 



 •    Strong working knowledge of labour law and statutory compliance.
 



 •    Excellent investigation, case\-management and documentation skills.
 



 •    Stakeholder management across Operations, Legal and employees at all levels.
 



 •    High emotional intelligence, discretion and conflict\-resolution ability.
 



 •    Team building and people leadership across a distributed, PAN India team.
 



 •    Data orientation — comfortable building and defending an attrition / case\-management dashboard/MIS.
 



 •    Ability to operate calmly and objectively in a fast\-paced, high\-volume, sensitive\-case environment.

title: Change Manager
description:
**Join our Team**
**About This Opportunity**
 Join our dynamic Telecom Operations team as a Change Manager, responsible for maintaining the integrity, performance, and availability of telecom networks (RAN, Core, Transmission, IP). You’ll lead the Change Advisory Board (CAB), oversee network change processes, and ensure compliance with ITIL standards, Ericsson policies, and customer SLAs.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Lead CAB and CCB: Manage CAB meetings, approve network changes, and handle critical/emergency decisions.
* Assess Change Impact: Analyze service and KPI impact (e.g., latency, call drop) of planned changes; mitigate risks during rollouts.
* Process \& Compliance: Ensure proper documentation, audit readiness, and alignment with SOPs using ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Remedy).
* Reporting \& Automation: Deliver post\-change reports and support automation via Excel, Python, or BI tools.
* Cross\-Functional Coordination: Work with engineering, GNOC, MSIP, field ops, and vendors (Ericsson, Nokia, Huawei, Cisco).
* Security Compliance: Enforce network security policies and support ISO 27001/NIST\-aligned practices.


**The skills you bring:**
* Education: Bachelor’s in Electronics, Telecom, or Computer Engineering.
* Experience: 3\-5 years in network operations/change management; exposure to OSS/BSS, NFV is a plus.
* Certifications: ITIL Foundation (mandatory); CCNA, JNCIA, or Ericsson training preferred.
* Technical Skills: Strong telecom network knowledge, ITSM tools, protocols (IP, SNMP, SIP), and BI/reporting proficiency.
* Soft Skills: Effective communicator in English/Hindi, strong leadership, and decision\-making in high\-stakes situations.


**“All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.”**

title: Administrative Manager
description:
**About the company:** 




 BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. Its a leading service provider for the mid\-markets with client service at its heart.
 



  





 BDO India Services Private Limited (or BDO India) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory \& assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300\+ Partners \& Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3\-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi\-fold.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 The Manager – Administration will oversee workplace and facility operations to ensure a safe, efficient, compliant, and employee\-friendly office environment. The role will be responsible for office administration, facilities management, vendor governance, workplace services, security, maintenance, compliance, and employee support functions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Workplace \& Facilities Management** 



* Manage day\-to\-day administration of office facilities, including workstations, cabins, meeting rooms, and common areas.
* Ensure optimal space utilization and workplace readiness.



  





**Employee Support \& Workplace Experience** 



* Coordinate onboarding and exit processes, including workspace setup and clearance activities.
* Partner with HR to enhance employee experience and support engagement initiatives.



  





**Events \& Employee Engagement** 



* Plan and execute townhalls, leadership meetings, employee engagement programs, and corporate events.



  





**Vendor \& Contract Staff Management** 



* Manage outsourced staff and facility vendors, ensuring service quality, productivity, and SLA compliance.
* Oversee housekeeping, pantry, security, pest control, and other soft services.



  





**Cafeteria Operations** 



* Manage canteen operations, hygiene standards, vendor performance, and employee feedback mechanisms.



  





**Compliance \& Regulatory Management** 



* Ensure adherence to statutory, administrative, and organizational compliance requirements.
* Coordinate with local authorities and regulatory bodies for approvals, inspections, and audits.



  





**Budgeting, Billing \& MIS** 



* Manage vendor billing, budget tracking, invoice verification, and administrative cost control.
* Prepare MIS reports, dashboards, and management reviews.



  





**Safety, Security \& Maintenance** 



* Oversee fire safety systems, emergency preparedness, mock drills, and statutory compliance.
* Manage physical security, access control, CCTV monitoring, and visitor management.
* Monitor preventive maintenance schedules and ensure timely resolution of facility\-related issues.



  





**Inventory \& Asset Management** 



* Maintain office assets, consumables, and inventory.
* Conduct periodic audits and ensure optimal stock availability.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Graduate/Postgraduate in Administration, Facilities Management, Hospitality, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in Administration, Facilities Management, Workplace Operations, Corporate Services, or Office Management.
* Strong experience in facility operations, vendor management, office administration, and employee support services.
* Exposure to security, maintenance, compliance, and contract staff management preferred.
* Experience managing corporate office environments and multiple vendors will be an advantage.

title: RC-PROCESS and CONTROLS-SOX-Manager-NDA
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**EY\_ Consulting \_ SOX – Manager**
 As part of our Consulting Enterprise Risk team, our clients look for EY’s expertise across the consulting solutions and specifically for engagements related to Internal Audit, Process compliance and reviews, SOX 404, Payment application, Developing Standard Operating Procedure manuals, Third Party Risk Management, Regulatory Compliance and Enterprise Risk Management.
   

  

 There really is no average day in this role, since every client will have multi\-faceted challenges and a distinct business environment. What it means is that you’ll have an opportunity to learn and adapt to our clients’ cultures and contribute towards developing unique solutions that are tailored to individual engagements. Whichever industry or client you’re working with, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to expand your business network and transform yourself into a truly global professional.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 This is client\-facing role in a rapidly growing practice, where you’ll build client relationships with key stakeholders, including management executives for some of the most globally recognized brands. It makes this the perfect place to gain a deeper understanding of complex businesses transactions, all the while recommending solutions to some of the most pressing business challenges and process inefficiencies. You'll also team with our performance improvement professionals in multidisciplinary engagements, helping major global clients transform and sustain business performance. The team is focused on leveraging emerging technologies like Robotics, AI, Advanced Analytics to enhance various Internal Audit and internal control solutions being provided to the client and actively work in building multiple tools and assets for efficient and effective client delivery. By plugging into our market\-leading global network, you'll gain the experience you need to become an exceptional Risk Advisor
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Delivery and Team management
* Manage a team of Staffs and Seniors (across locations) to manage delivery of the SOX engagements \- including scoping, test of design, test of effectiveness and reporting – for multiple processes across clients
* Provide guidance to Staffs and Seniors to conduct effective assessment to comply to Sarbanes\-Oxley (SOX) compliance
* Conduct / Lead control rationalization and standardization activity or re\-design existing controls for business processes
* Evaluate control gaps noted during design or operating effectiveness testing, provide recommendations and track remediation
* Responsible to define budget, track actuals against the budget and resource planning / scheduling
* Independently manage client process owners with minimal supervision
* Meet quality guidelines within the established turnaround time (or allotted budget) to drive the value for the client
* Demonstrate application and solution\-based approach to problem solving while executing client engagements
* Anticipate and identify engagement related risks and escalate issues as appropriate on a timely basis
* Design and lead area specific transition plan within agreed timelines
* Spear head the team performing analytics and benchmarking activities for clients
* Drive process automation and implement opportunities for continuous improvements


**Market Leadership and client management**
* Executive\-level skills in client relationship management and the hold conversations with senior executives.
* Partnering with onshore teams to understand client’s business \& related industry issues / trends for global clients.
* Identify buyers, influencers \& stakeholders in existing client engagements and build strong relationships.
* Assist Senior Managers / Directors in driving the account management agenda by focusing on high impact opportunities.
* Contribute to new solution development basis the industry trends and client’s problem statement
* Conduct knowledge sharing discussions \& contribute to EY thought leadership.


**Supports in responding to RFP / RFIs**
* Support multiple innovation initiatives to enhance existing solutions leveraging emerging technologies like Robotics, AI, Advanced Analytics
* Collaborating with colleagues across multiple service lines, sharing your knowledge and experience to guide business decisions.
* Monitoring industry news, tools and trends while suggesting potential risks, as well as opportunities to improve the way we work.


**Operational Excellence**
* Suggest ideas on improving engagement productivity and identify opportunities for improving client service.
* Manage engagement budgets and ensure compliance with engagement plans and internal quality \& risk management procedures.


**People related**
* Display teamwork, integrity and leadership. Work with team members to set goals and responsibilities for specific engagements. Foster teamwork and innovation.
* Utilize technology \& tools to continually learn and innovate, share knowledge with team members and enhance service delivery.
* Understand EY and its service lines. Actively encourage team members to contribute ideas.
* Conduct workshops and technical training sessions for team members. Contribute to the learning \& development agenda and knowledge harnessing initiatives.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Exceptional command on spoken and written English
* Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations
* Highly analytical, organized and meticulous consulting skills
* Strong academic history (degree in Business, Accounting, or similar work experience in similar industry, Big 4 preferred)
* Proficient in MS\-Office Suite, data analysis \& validation
* Team player with strong interpersonal skills
* Ability to prioritize deliverables effectively in order to achieve optimum results.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* More than 7 years of a “Big 4” or professional firm or professional industry experience in risks \& controls, with more than 4 years of experience in SOX / internal controls
* Strong understanding of SOX and COSO framework
* CIA certification is preferred
* Strong academic history (degree in Business, Accounting, Engineering or similar)
* Strong multi\-project management skills
* Skilled at collaborating, motivating and guiding high performance teams.
* Cognitive problem solving capabilities, quick decision making skills and ability to handle complex situations with a calm demeanor
* Exceptional command on spoken and written English
* Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations
* Team player with strong interpersonal skills
* Ability to think differently and innovate


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Responsible for the performance and appraisal of direct reports, including training and developing necessary skill sets to enable them to grow in their careers.
* Mentor and coach junior team members, enabling them to meet their performance goals and successfully grow their careers.


**What We Look For**
 A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
   

  

 Opportunities to work with EY Risk \-Internal Audit practices global with leading businesses across a range of industries
   

  

**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
